items.headline: Rasmus Hojlund departs Manchester United to join Napoli permanently
items.summary: Striker Rasmus Hojlund has left Manchester United and joined Italian club Napoli on a permanent transfer deal.

items.headline: Benjamin Sesko returns to grass training after injury during pre-season
items.summary: Slovenian striker Benjamin Sesko, 23, has recovered from injury and resumed training on grass as Manchester United prepares for the new season.

items.headline: Andrey Santos and Youri Tielemans confirmed as Manchester United signings
items.summary: Midfielder Andrey Santos joined from Chelsea for £48m plus £2m add-ons. Belgium captain Youri Tielemans, 29, signed from Aston Villa after activating release clause.
